Life is hopeless.
Teaching someone how to think without teaching them how to care is useless.
Humans have the freedom to make their own choices.
It is good to work hard to get famous, rich, and powerful.

Feeling good and being happy is the most important thing in life.
I do not care about what is considered right or wrong.
It is impossible to prove anything for sure.
I want fame and riches more than a happy, meaningful life.

The world of thoughts and ideas is better than the real physical world.

Our main goal in life should be chasing our own hobbies and fun.
Good and bad are real things that exist outside of just human opinion.

Big ideas like fairness and freedom are very important to me.
We should always make fun of people in power.
We can never see or experience the world exactly as it truly is.

tests.name: Economics
tests.description: How do you think the economy should be run? See your results across multiple economic views.
tests.preamble: You will be asked a number of statements. Indicate whether you broadly agree or disagree. Please answer as honestly as possible.
tests.instruction: How much do you agree or disagree with the following statement?

A country must produce its own basic needs, like food and water, without relying on others.
When the government gets involved in business, it threatens personal freedom and leads to control.
Giving every citizen a basic monthly payment from the government is a good and doable idea.
We should not have large factories or mass production in our economy.
The government should set limits on how much items can cost.
Rich people and big companies should pay higher taxes to fund public services.
The government should tax imports and support local businesses to protect them from foreign competition.
The government needs to step into the economy to make sure wealth is shared fairly.

Our economy should focus mostly on farming and natural resources.
The government should create long-term, multi-year plans to run the economy.
Expensive luxury items should have high taxes.
We should have local, member-owned groups that produce their own goods.
The government should be able to strictly punish businesses that harm the public.
Schools and hospitals should be owned and run by the government.
Our economy should be designed around protecting nature.
Economic laws should be flexible so they can change easily when needed.
Protecting inventions with government patents is good for business.
The government should stay out of people's private business.
Trains and public transport should be run by the government.

Putting limits and taxes on foreign trade is a good thing.
We should encourage small, independent local projects.
An economy completely planned by the government is the best system.
Banks should be owned and run by the government.
The economy should be driven by businesses competing and people buying things.
A larger government with more control is always better.
Taxes should be as low as possible, only paying for basics like the police.
Government policies that interfere with free trade do not work.
Nations and global organizations should support and depend on each other economically.
Private companies work best when left completely alone.
Global companies do a better job than government-run programs.
Countries must build modern industries and technology to succeed.

International companies should be allowed to set up shop anywhere they want.
An economy based on hunting and gathering is better than a modern one.
The economy should grow naturally without any plans or government rules.
Government attempts to create a perfect society threaten economic success.
A modern, global economy where countries connect is unavoidable and good.
Money and currency are the most important parts of a working economy.
Economic systems should be relaxed, with very little paperwork or strict setup.
Everyone should pay the exact same tax percentage, no matter how much they earn.
Protecting local businesses by blocking foreign trade has been bad for the economy.
The economy should serve the government, not the other way around.
We should encourage lifestyles focused on making profit and lending money for interest.
A strong government staff is needed to enforce laws and keep things running smoothly.
The government should control all the main details of the nation's economy.
The government must have a lot of control for the economy to work properly.
We should work toward creating one single economy for the whole world.
Official government departments are needed to keep order and run the economy.
Expert teams should run different parts of the economy instead of one large government agency.

tests.name: Political Philosophy
tests.description: Find your underlying political philosophy through core concept questions.
tests.preamble: State whether you agree or disagree overall with these philosophical statements.
tests.instruction: How much do you agree or disagree with the following statement?

questions.text: We live in a world where there is no single 'true' reality, only different viewpoints.
A perfect democracy where everyone has an equal say is impossible in real life.
We shouldn't question our leaders or government as long as they keep the peace.
A world where everyone ends up with equal wealth and success is a great goal.
The traditional family setup forces people to be blindly obedient and leads to extreme control.
Forcing an individual to do things for the sake of the group is wrong.
It is an unchangeable rule that all human societies will eventually become corrupt and fail.
The move to big factories and modern industry has done more harm than good.
Every civilization goes through a birth, a rise and a fall.
We must respect and protect our community's traditional laws and founding rules.
Society's rules, history, and organizations are biased and set up by powerful groups to control others.
Religion and spirituality are just distractions; humans have no purpose beyond enjoying physical life.
Good and evil are personal opinions, and an action is only good if it has a good result.
We must treat everyone equally and eliminate all unfair biases and hardships faced by minority groups.
Technology and human effort will naturally keep making the world a better place.
To find true meaning in life, you must have discipline and higher spiritual values.
People cannot be fully trusted, so everyone must do their duty to protect the community.
Humans are naturally peaceful equals who deserve complete freedom from arbitrary limits like race or gender.
Our modern world of free democracy is steadily moving toward a perfect society.
There is a deeper, non-physical meaning to life beyond just chasing fun.
Every person has a soul, and we are judged by our actions.
Human nature is naturally cruel and chaotic, so we need a strong leader to maintain order.
Without God, high ideals, and deep traditions, our society will completely fall apart.
Modern ideas of progress are actually a sign of decay, and without strict rules, society will ruin itself.
Social rankings are unavoidable; some will always rule while others are ruled, and some will always succeed more.
True equality is impossible in any organization, and successful people usually earn their success.

tests.preamble: Indicate how much you agree or disagree with these combined summaries of relationship dynamics.
tests.instruction: How much do you agree or disagree with the following statement?

questions.text: When someone hurts or offends me, it is extremely important that they apologize, admit they were wrong, and understand my pain.

When people say I hurt them, they are usually just being selfish, failing to see things from my side, or ignoring how they hurt me first.
It is very hard for me to stop thinking about times people mistreated me, and I still feel flooded with anger days later.
